title: Day and Trial Passes: membership-conversion credit, extension fee, and weather-policy extension
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: the bill credit earned toward a new membership's enrollment fee when converting within the conversion window, the days allowed for that window, the fee and maximum days for a staff-granted extension of validity, and whether and how many days validity is extended at no charge under the weather policy.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | Conversion discount (USD) | Conversion window (days) | Extension fee (USD) | Extension maximum (days) | Weather extension allowed | Weather extension (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | 25.00 | 7 | 0.00 | 0 | Yes | 1 |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | 45.00 | 10 | 10.00 | 2 | Yes | 1 |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | 79.00 | 14 | 15.00 | 3 | Yes | 2 |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | 50.00 | 14 | 15.00 | 3 | Yes | 2 |
| Monthly Trial Pass | 100.00 | 30 | 25.00 | 7 | Yes | 3 |
| Corporate Guest Pass | 25.00 | 7 | 0.00 | 0 | Yes | 1 |

The conversion discount is the dollar amount credited toward a new membership's enrollment fee when the visitor converts within the conversion window of that tier. The extension fee is the charge for staff to extend that tier's validity, up to the extension maximum number of days; a Single Day Pass and a Corporate Guest Pass define no extension (fee and maximum both zero) because their one-day validity window admits no extension. Every tier permits a no-charge weather-policy extension of up to the listed number of days when the club was closed for weather or an emergency during the pass's original validity window.
